## 4. Connectivity & Signal Flow
### Internal Connectivity:
- **Cell Inputs:** Battery cells connect through Fuses (F0-F16) -> RC Filters (R_VC/C_VC) -> VC0-VC16 pins of U1.
- **Balancing:** Internal MOSFETs of U1 connect through CB0-CB15 pins -> Balancing Resistors (R_CB) -> VCn nodes.
- **Power Supply:** The BAT pin of U1 is connected to the top of the 16-cell stack (VC16). An external NPN (Q1) is used to regulate the LDOIN voltage from BAT.
- **Reference Logic:** TSREF provides 5V to the thermistor divider network. GPIO1-8 are configured as analog inputs to measure the divider voltage.

### External Port Mapping (Per Module Boundary):
- **P1.1 (BAT):** Connected to VC16 (Top of stack).
- **P1.2 (VC0-VC16):** Connected to individual cell taps via fuses.
- **P1.3 (CB0-CB15):** Internal to the balancing loops.
- **P2.1 (COMH):** Isolated differential pair to the next module UP the stack.
- **P2.2 (COML):** Isolated differential pair to the next module DOWN the stack or Comm Bridge.
- **P3.1 (CVDD):** 5V regulated output routed to the Current Sensing module.
- **P3.2 (NFAULT):** Hardware signal from U1 (pin 34) to signal system-wide faults.

## 5. Uncertainties, Assumptions & Confidence
- **Isolation Method:** The reference schematic shows capacitive isolation (C_ISO). We assume capacitive isolation is sufficient for the 1000V DC requirement unless transformer isolation is mandated by further EMC/Safety analysis.
- **Balancing Resistor Value:** The value of 22 $\Omega$ is an assumption based on the 240mA target and internal MOSFET resistance (~1-2 $\Omega$). This needs verification against the maximum power dissipation of the chosen resistors.
- **Connector Specification:** The exact model for the daisy chain and cell connectors is currently unspecified in the boundary document. Standard automotive-grade headers (e.g., Molex Micro-Lock Plus) are assumed.
- **Confidence Level:** High for core ASIC functionality; Medium for specific connector and isolation component ratings until final selection.
